Bitcoin vs Gold: Which is a Better Long-Term Bet? (cross post v/preciousmetals)
The way I see it, buying bitcoin is a bet on whether there will be more use of modern technology or less in the future. I'll go with the former.

Bitcoin has some problems that gold doesn't. Namely, the whole Bitcoin unlimited fiasco and the potential of a hard fork. In the face of this problem, gold is a better long-term bet imo.

Also, my brother recently did a BTC transaction but had to wait about a week for the confirmations to come in. Granted he didn't pay any transaction fees, but this system has problems if nearly instantaneous confirmation is promised, but instead you have to wait a week.
